title: judicata reviewer output
description: What one reviewer run returns: one verdict per judgment criterion of the round, and findings outside the contract. Paths are relative to the project root.

criteria.description: Exactly one verdict for every judgment criterion you were given.

findings.description: Problems outside the contract: places in scope with a problem that no criterion covers. One entry per problem and place.

id.description: The criterion id, exactly as given.

passed.description: true if the artifact meets the criterion, false if not.

reason.description: One line: why it passes or fails.

evidence.description: Places that support the verdict. At least one when passed is false.

file.description: Path of an existing file, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number the quote starts at, exactly.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the file, starting at that line; it may run on over the following lines. Only whitespace may differ.

category.description: correctness, security or factual for real errors (wrong result, vulnerability, false statement); clarity, style, maintainability or other for everything else.

severity.description: Proposed severity. blocker only for correctness, security or factual with a concrete scenario in evidence. The core lowers it by its rules.

file.description: Path of an existing file inside the contract's scope, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number the quote starts at, exactly.

symbol.description: The enclosing function, method or class, qualified like Parser.parse. Leave it out for Markdown, prose and file-level places.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the file, starting at that line; it may run on over the following lines. Only whitespace may differ.

evidence.description: The concrete scenario: input or state that leads to the wrong result, the attack, or why the statement is false. Without it the finding is at most a note.
